content:
zoe (Finance): FYI ChannelX submitted a credit request for April invoices — they say duplicate marketplace lines after switching to reseller ingestion. CSV attached. @mike can you triage? :eyes:

mike (BillingOps): On it. paste 2-3 sample rows here so i can check invoice ids + partner order ids.

zoe (Finance): sample rows: invoice_id,partner_order_id,marketplace_sku,reported_tokens,charge_usd; inv-2024-04-312,ord-7753,redwood-gen-8k,1,234.50; inv-2024-04-312,ord-7753,redwood-gen-8k,1,234.50; inv-2024-04-498,ord-7821,embed-plus,0,0.00

aws-billing-bot: AWS Marketplace report: 2 duplicate line matches for inv-2024-04-312. report link: https://console.aws/marketplace/report/ABC123

mike (BillingOps): likely duplicate ingestion during partner migration. plan: 1) verify original AWS invoice IDs 2) diff PartnerX usage vs our ingestion logs 3) propose credit if dupes confirmed. @tara do credits > $5k need Sales approval?

tara (SalesOps): yes >$5k requires Sales manager sign-off + partner SLA review. i can OK up to $5k provisionally. include migration ticket and PoR.

sophie (Revenue Ops): accounting: use GL REB-CR-2024 and keep original rev dates. need credit booked in May close if approved. reason_code: duplicate_ingestion_after_reseller_migration

jared (Legal): note: channel agreement 7.2 says retro credits >60 days need PO or amendment. when was migration?

mike (BillingOps): migration kickoff 2024-03-27 (MIT-432) so within 60 days. i'll run ingestion diff and upload reconciliation CSV by EOD.

zoe (Finance): action items: @mike run reconciliation + propose amount; @tara provisional approval up to $5k; @jared confirm legal signature not needed; @sophie prepare GL mapping. target internal decision by 2024-05-03 for May close.

mike (BillingOps): uploading reconciliation to s3://redwood-billing/recons/channelx/1915004321-recon.csv by 18:00 PT.

tara (SalesOps): :white_check_mark: ping me when amount is posted, i'll prep approval note if < $5k.

zoe (Finance): thanks all. if partner escalation required i'll set quick 15m sync. :calendar:
